589 |     /// Every Lance-format file this fragment references: the base data files
590 |     /// plus the data file of each overlay. The fragment's other referenced
591 |     /// files are not in this format: a deletion file is `.arrow` or `.bin`, and
592 |     /// external row-id or row-version metadata is a raw byte range.
593 |     ///
594 |     /// Prefer this over `files`, which is the base data files only and so omits
595 |     /// overlays.
596 |     pub fn referenced_lance_files(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &DataFile> + '_ {
597 |         // Destructured on purpose: a new field here fails to compile until
598 |         // someone decides whether it references files.
599 |         let Self {
600 |             id: _,
601 |             files,
602 |             overlays,
603 |             deletion_file: _,
604 |             row_id_meta: _,
605 |             physical_rows: _,
606 |             last_updated_at_version_meta: _,
607 |             created_at_version_meta: _,
608 |         } = self;
609 |         files
610 |             .iter()
611 |             .chain(overlays.iter().map(|overlay| &overlay.data_file))
612 |     }

345 |     /// Get the latest version of a dataset at the base_uri
346 |     async fn get_latest_version(&self, base_uri: &str) -> Result<Option<(u64, String)>> {
347 |         self.get_latest_manifest_location(base_uri)
348 |             .await
349 |             .map(|location| location.map(|loc| (loc.version, loc.path.to_string())))
350 |     }

352 |     async fn get_latest_manifest_location(
353 |         &self,
354 |         base_uri: &str,
355 |     ) -> Result<Option<ManifestLocation>> {
356 |         let query_result = self
357 |             .ddb_query()
358 |             .key_condition_expression(format!("{} = :{}", base_uri!(), base_uri!()))
359 |             .expression_attribute_values(
360 |                 format!(":{}", base_uri!()),
361 |                 AttributeValue::S(base_uri.into()),
362 |             )
363 |             .scan_index_forward(false)
364 |             .limit(1)
365 |             .send()
366 |             .await
367 |             .wrap_err()?;
